1. First incident: Wang4 participated in group assault with knives, guns, causing injuries: victim severe injury (right leg heavy injury, head light injury). This is intentional injury (故意伤害) causing heavy injury. So crime: 故意伤害.

2. Second incident: Wang4 participated in group smashing a car with axe, causing property damage valued 5390 yuan. That's destruction of property (故意毁坏财物) maybe "故意毁坏财物" or "故意毁坏公私财物". In examples, they used "故意毁坏财物" for similar. So crime: 故意毁坏财物.

3. Third incident: Wang4 participated in robbery (抢劫). So crime: 抢劫.

Thus three crimes: 故意伤害;故意毁坏财物;抢劫
